issues.reason: Status predicates states an appositive has no tense of its own and its typing atom takes the host clause's wrapper, and the host 'said' is past, so the bare (Member geraldine_andrews daughter_in_law) violates that rule.

The same rule says a past-tense copular wraps EVERY categorical atom the clause yields (the Member/Inheritance and any PartOf alike), so the appositive's sibling Possession atom must carry the same Past wrapper rather than stand as an untensed fact beside a tensed one.

Coreference & anaphora resolves an anaphor to the most salient compatible antecedent by gender/number agreement plus recency; Robinson is unmarked for gender (hence not incompatible with 'her') and is both the more recent mention and the subject of the very clause containing the pronoun, so the parser's resolution is licensed and asserts no gender claim about anyone.

Core patterns' sealing rule projects only a definite referent's Member / Name typing atom and Propositional attitudes expressly bars P's predications, so a top-level (Possession sk_daughter_1 robinson) asserts as fact a relation the sentence only reports Geraldine as saying.

Compound concepts requires a single lemma unless a compound is genuinely needed, and 'out of a mental health facility' is the literal motion-result path already carried by (Source <event> <from>), so fusing take_out records the particle a second time on top of the Source atom.

new_gaps: 'recently' — a vague past-proximity adverb naming an interval rather than one of the listed point-like deictic constants (yesterday / today / last_week …); it is parked bare on Time with nothing in the instruction set licensing that filler.
repair_summary: Wrapped both appositive atoms in Past per the appositive/host-tense rule. Moved (Possession sk_daughter_1 robinson) inside the sealed Theme term, leaving only the daughter's typing atom projected. Replaced the fused take_out class with the single lemma take (event witness renamed sk_take_1 to match the convention), keeping the Source oblique that carries 'out of'.
notes: 'her' is genuinely ambiguous between Geraldine and Robinson, and pronoun resolution is not one of the three multiple-reading triggers, so the parser had to pick one and its pick is licensed. The sealed compound-genus atom (Inheritance mental_health_facility facility) was left exactly where the parser put it, since no issue names it.
